sloka: यम् त्व् एनम् अभिसम्रब्धम् प्लवमानम् इव स्थितम् ।प्रेक्षन्ते वानराः सर्वे स्थितम् यूथप यूथपम् ॥६-२७-१५॥।।
transliteration: yam tv enam abhisamrabdham plavamānam iva sthitam ।prekṣante vānarāḥ sarve sthitam yūthapa yūthapam ॥6-27-15॥।।

translations.english: "O king! This Lord of monkeys, whom whether he is jumping like monkeys or standing is the leader of the leaders, whom the monkeys are looking at standing is called Dhamba, a mighty powerful, fearsome leader and Lord of monkeys. He is surrounded by a strong army like the thousand eyed Indra."
translations.hindi: उसके शारीर में बड़े बड़े बाल हैं, वे राक्षस और पिशाचों की तरह क्रररच भाव हैं। जाम्बवान की अग्नि के समान तेजसम्पन्न बड़ी सेना है, जो इधर.उधर विचरा करती हे
